name: How do I choose a contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel, look for one with experience in universal design or accessible home modifications. Check their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references. Ensure they are licensed, bonded, and insured in California. A good contractor will understand your specific needs, communicate clearly, and be knowledgeable about ADA guidelines and local building codes. Get multiple bids and compare proposals thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, check their license and references, and ensure they understand ADA guidelines and local codes.
